# OCF Schemas (v1.2.0 — vendored stubs)

This directory contains minimal JSON schema stubs for OCF object types used by
OpenCap Lite's import/export. They are NOT the full upstream OCF schemas; they
capture only the fields OpenCap Lite reads or writes.

Upstream: https://github.com/Open-Cap-Table-Coalition/Open-Cap-Format-OCF

When the full v1.2.0 schemas are vendored, swap these stubs for the real
`schema/objects/*.schema.json` files.
